review.body: { let span = cli_common :: observation :: scope ("HOST" , "sig:design:storage" , "storage::MemoryStore::audit_history" , & ()) ; let result = (| | { for rows in self . history . values () { for row in rows { verify_row (row) ? ; } if rows . windows (2) . any (| pair | { pair [0] . closes_at != Some (pair [1] . version . opens_at) || pair [0] . version . opens_at >= pair [1] . version . opens_at }) || rows . last () . is_some_and (| row | row . closes_at . is_some ()) { return Err (StorageError :: CorruptHistory) ; } } Ok (()) }) () ; let result = classified (result) ; span . finish (& result) ; result }
review.item_premise: Explicit full memory audit checks each public payload digest and canonical envelope, interval contiguity and the open terminal row. It takes no private configuration and makes no observation-dependent choice. Boundary load does not substitute for this complete audit.
